title: Nine Days of Describing
subtitle: 战争和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：chaos　|　正文 333 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chaos 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1943 my mother was sent to describe ① chaos she could not end, and she said the describing was the whole of the lesson. The ② chaos, meaning the disorder and not the war, was nine days long and was described by whoever came last; chaos, she said, is the only thing in a city that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chaos in that city had the same sound, and the ④ chaos at the end, meaning the one the reporters kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever described properly. Chaos, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chaos was the whole of the century, meaning the loss it carried and not the disorder. The ⑥ chaos, meaning the loss and not any of that, is the only thing in a century that everybody survives and nobody questions; chaos, he said, is either something you describe or the only word that means both disorder and a loss. She said the loss is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ chaos had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the sound. The ⑧ chaos of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine days and eleven years of describing; chaos, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chaos I remember is the one at the end, which was described in 1963 and is still described as the worst in the county. A ⑩ chaos, my grandmother said in 1968, is the only thing that improves by being described; every chaos, she said, is a loss that has agreed to look like disorder. She said the loss was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 混乱（指那场无序本身，与那场战争相对）
C. 固定搭配：describe a chaos 描述一场混乱
D. n. 混乱（指那座城市里每一场）
E. n. 混乱（指末尾那一场）
F. n. 失序之痛（抽象：它承载的那份损失）
G. n. 那份损失（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chaos, meaning the disorder and not the war
chaos was the whole of the century
the chaos had become a number in a report
The chaos of the whole thing
A chaos, my grandmother said in 1968

answers.why: describe a chaos 意为“描述一场混乱”，1943 年母亲被派去描述她结束不了的那场混乱。
chaos 意为“混乱、杂乱”，指那场无序本身而不是那场战争，长九天，由最后来的人描述。
chaos 指那座城市里每一场混乱，每一场都是同样的声音。
chaos 指末尾那一场（记者保留的那一场），是唯一有人认真描述过的。
chaos 意为“失序之痛”，抽象指它承载的那份损失，父亲说 chaos 就是那个世纪的全部。
chaos 为抽象用法，指那份损失本身，是一个世纪里人人都熬过、却没人质疑的东西。
chaos 意为“混乱、杂乱”，到 1958 年这场 chaos 成了报告里的一个数字。
chaos 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九天和十一年的描述。
chaos 意为“混乱”，我记得的是末尾那一场，1963 年被描述，至今仍被说成全县最糟的。
chaos 为抽象总称，祖母说一场混乱是唯一会因为被认真描述而变好的东西。
